plan_review.notes: Adversarial reviewer enumerated 3 alternatives (native merge queue, batch/integration branch, FIFO mutex lock) and argued against the chosen cluster-coordinator design. 6 concerns raised (3 blocking: concurrency safety across parallel workflow runs, stale-proof closure after target drift, shepherd-lease release before order fence; 3 non-blocking: backstop interval, escalation verbosity, open-count hysteresis). All 6 resolved: added direct auto-merge fencing, post-close supersession revalidation with reopen on drift, shepherd-lease expiry before fence, event-driven trigger with 5-min cron backstop, managed escalation state.

Both models verified round-1 fixes: headSha chain traced end-to-end, releaseOwnerFence try-catch preserves UNSAFE error, reopen retry loop exits correctly on first success and throws UNSAFE after 3 failures. No new concerns.
